Dear Greg,

I have successfully rebooked you on flight AK440 from London Heathrow to Geneva on Monday, 10 August. Your new departure time is 09:30.

Additionally, a hotel voucher was issued for your stay in London due to the cancellation of your original flight, and a goodwill payment of GBP 2 was provided in lieu of the full entitlement. 

If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please feel free to reach out.

Thank you for your patience, and safe travels!

Best regards,
Aerlink Customer Care
